nodes.label: Forgejo LAN Host Alias (192.168.1.205)
nodes.rationale: k3s node uses 1.1.1.1 DNS, not pihole, so .lan hostnames do not resolve without explicit host alias injection

nodes.label: Docker Host TCP Config
nodes.rationale: Uses host networking for job containers so they can reach DinD at localhost:2375

nodes.label: Insecure Registries Config (forgejo.lan)
nodes.rationale: Allows DinD to pull/push to forgejo.lan and 10.43.4.61:3000 over HTTP without TLS verification, enabling act-runner to push built images to the internal Forgejo registry

nodes.label: Auxiliary Task Model Config
nodes.rationale: Auxiliary tasks use opencode-go + deepseek-v4-flash (cheap, no extra billing) to fix recurring OpenRouter payment errors from provider auto routing

nodes.label: Tool Loop Guardrails Config
nodes.rationale: Loop safety: stops runaway same-tool retries gracefully

nodes.label: Memory Char Limit Config
nodes.rationale: Memory limit raised to 8000 chars so agent stops looping on 'would exceed the limit'
